answer: The evidence covers several pivotal trials, so it depends which one you mean. For PALOMA-2, the primary analysis (palbociclib + letrozole) showed a progression-free survival benefit, but overall survival data were immature at that time, and it was uncertain whether the PFS benefit would translate into longer survival. For PALOMA-3 (palbociclib + fulvestrant), an updated exploratory analysis at 73.3 months' follow-up (after 75% of patients had died) showed continued improvement in median overall survival versus fulvestrant alone, compared with the earlier 44.8-month analysis. If you need details on PALOMA-1, INAVO120, or PATINA, please escalate to Medical Information for full trial data.
